local_additions.origin: per-GSE reference DEG list (pig-to-human direct symbol + homologene mapping to the L1000 978 landmark genes); tracked before the restructure
full pig-to-human L1000 DEG table; regenerable, never tracked (global *.csv rule)

note: manifest, verified_at, verify_result and tree_sha256 are filled by ticket 09
notes: GEO ACCESSION: GSE137293 (Sus scrofa, Illumina NovaSeq 6000). CAVEAT: the series has no sham control — the comparison is scar (infarct core) vs border zone (peri-infarct), which captures an injury-severity gradient rather than disease vs healthy. The gene set is derived by direct human-readable symbol matching plus homologene (inTax 9823) and filtered to the L1000 978 landmarks (map_to_human.R:species2human). Split from the old shared `miri/` level under `disease_data/` in ticket 05 (spec §4).
